verdict.rationale: The product ships its own background automation. Users can set payroll to run automatically after initial setup, with alerts. Auto payroll covers salaried employees on direct deposit, Payroll AI proactively collects time data and texts admins, taxes are calculated, filed and paid automatically, and multi-step HR processes can be automated with custom approval chains. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation builder (custom triggers/actions) beyond payroll and HR flows, auto payroll covering hourly employees and those not on direct deposit, detail on how configurable the AI agent's autonomy is, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
